about:
Nihm Electronic Solutions was founded in 2010 by James Bench in Las Vegas, Nevada. The company began as a contract manufacturer focused on custom wire harnesses and electronic circuit board assemblies, aiming to support the quick-turn, mixed-volume needs of OEMs and other contract manufacturers.

Today, Nihm produces wire harnesses, cable assemblies, printed circuit board assemblies (PCBA) using surface-mount technology, and 3D-printed prototypes via FDM and stereolithography. The shop also offers material engraving on metal, glass, wood, plastic, and 3D-printed parts through a partnership with Benchmarx Engraving. Operations run with no minimum or maximum order quantities, accommodating small runs and prototype quantities alike.

The company serves the transportation, medical, robotics, gaming, and communications industries. Its customer base includes original equipment manufacturers and fellow contract manufacturers seeking design-build services, reverse engineering, and first-article inspection.

Nihm differentiates itself with 100% testing on every unit, IPC 610/620-certified assemblers, a Komax Alpha 530 automated wire processor with crimp-force monitoring, and a DI water polishing system for fiber-optic cables. The quality program includes cross-section analysis, CPK process-capability tracking, and CAMI Research computer-guided testers that record pass/fail data for each harness.
